_doc: Render massing for K in Kortrijk (shopping centre, Robbrecht en Daem 2010), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (OSM way 1014884611 centroid), u along 'axis_deg' (the glass roof's long axis on the 2024 orthophoto, degrees CCW from grid east). Heights from DHMV II: flat roofs 16.5-17.2 m (north wing 12-15 m), glass roof top 25 m. Shape from the Digitaal Vlaanderen orthophotos (summer 2024, winter 2025; open data) and Commons photos (refs/): a dark stone block with a flat dark roof and a large glass HIP roof (112 x 28 m, light blue-grey, flat light strip on top) over the inner square, not a barrel. The hip is a gable along u plus a pyramid at each end. Sint-Janstoren (GRB 363006, 46 m in OSM, DSM 43.5 m): white stepped residential tower on a dark grey plinth, roof garden; its massing is in ../sint-janstoren/massing.json (own anchor). GRB 944613 (a 'verdieping' strip under the west end of the glass, 25.4 m from 3D GRB) is replaced too: it is the glass roof, not a building. GRB 4600487 (the south-west wing, 3D GRB 20.9 m, rendered as a big slate gable) is the same flat dark roof on the orthophoto (DSM 16.5 m) and is replaced by the block too. Glass rect checked against the orthophoto overlay.
